# multi-playwright-mcp

> Multi-session wrapper around @playwright/mcp — run multiple isolated browser instances via a single MCP server.

## Overview

Extends Microsoft's official Playwright MCP server with a `sessionId` parameter on every tool. Each unique sessionId gets its own isolated browser context (cookies, storage, viewport). Enables parallel browser automation from a single MCP connection.

## Key Features

- All 40+ Playwright MCP tools available with added `sessionId` isolation
- Multiple concurrent browsers (e.g., research in one, testing in another)
- Session lifecycle: auto-created on first use, explicit close via `close_session`
- `list_sessions`: see all active browser sessions
- Compatible with any MCP client (Claude Code, Kiro CLI, etc.)

## Tools (inherited from @playwright/mcp + additions)

- browser_navigate, browser_click, browser_type, browser_snapshot, browser_screenshot
- browser_tabs (list/new/close/select), browser_evaluate, browser_console_messages
- browser_network_requests, browser_cookie_*, browser_localstorage_*
- browser_file_upload, browser_drag, browser_drop, browser_route
- list_sessions, close_session (multi-session management)

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g multi-playwright-mcp
# or run directly:
npx multi-playwright-mcp
```

## Configuration (MCP client)

```json
{
  "command": "node",
  "args": ["/path/to/multi-playwright-mcp/dist/index.js"],
  "env": {"DISPLAY": ":1"}
}
```
